name: MegaFon
note: Zenit and Krylia Sovetov partner. Rating note: not rated. As of early 2023 named press (The Moscow Times, 30 Jan 2023; RBC, 21 Feb 2023) reported MegaFon 100% owned by Alisher Usmanov's private USM Group (claim megafon-usm-ownership, made historical). Since then the chain has gone opaque: MegaFon's 2025 IFRS statements (audited 5 Mar 2026) say the shares are held 50/50 by two Russia-registered companies whose common ultimate controlling entity is itself owned by a group of participants no one of whom controls it alone, with names withheld under Russia's 2023 sensitive-information rules (see the owner record). In 2023 Kommersant and RBC also reported state-controlled Rostelecom sought government approval to buy MegaFon; no completed sale is on record, and the 2024 annual report says the state holds no charter capital. The current ultimate owner is not publicly identified, so no 'none' rating can be justified until it is.
